observations.claim: The stock module alias compatible soc,fan matches the NX809J target overlay node qcom,fan@ef00. The scoped source review also matches the stock alias and the overlay hash.
observations.classification: device ownership/scope confirmed; runtime overlay application not confirmed

observations.claim: The target overlay ties fan,avdd-supply to pmh0101_l8 and sets fan,voltage=3300000; the stock probe calls regulator_get with id fan,avdd, reads fan,voltage, falls back to 2800000 if the read fails, and passes the selected value as both min_uV and max_uV to regulator_set_voltage.
observations.classification: static property/API mapping; 3.3 V interpretation is a unit-level inference, physical voltage unverified

observations.claim: The overlay sets pinctrl-names default and pinctrl-0 to fan_speed and fan_pwm. The stock probe requests pinctrl, looks up state default, and calls pinctrl_select_state.

The overlay maps fan,speed-gpio to TLMM GPIO 211 active-high and fan,pwm-gpio to PMH0101 GPIO 9 active-high. Stock nb_fan_gpio_proc requests the speed GPIO, converts it to IRQ, registers the threaded handler and disables the IRQ; it reads the raw PWM GPIO, while fan_level_set uses gpiod_direction_output_raw for level-dependent output.
observations.classification: static property-to-API map; line polarity and physical signal behavior not hardware validated

observations.claim: The child node is label fan and contains pwms=&fan_pwm_dev, channel cell 3, period cell 40000; stock parser requires one available child, matches the fan label, obtains a PWM through devm_fwnode_pwm_get and invokes the PWM apply callback.
observations.classification: static DT/PWM consumer mapping; provider binding at runtime unconfirmed

observations.claim: The referenced fan_pwm_dev node has compatible qcom,pm8350c-pwm, reg 0xeb00 and #pwm-cells=2. Pinned leds-qcom-lpg.c matches this compatible; its PM8350C data has four channels and channel entry 3 at base 0xeb00, and lpg_pwm_ops.apply points to lpg_pwm_apply.
observations.classification: static compatible/channel match; not proof the overlay/provider is active at runtime

observations.claim: The stock module has three KCFI-checked indirect calls through pwm_device->chip->ops->apply with type ID 0xddd097d0; pinned pwm_ops.apply has the matching int (pwm_chip*, pwm_device*, const pwm_state*) prototype, and the local provider implementation has that signature.
evidence: pwm_source_contracts_MP6_20261027.txt include/linux/pwm.h callback ABI and lpg_pwm_apply signature
observations.classification: ABI/callback mapping; target implementation conditional on runtime bind

observations.claim: The stock uses period 40000 in its level setter and PWM sysfs store; the store derives duty as input_percent*400, while level control derives duty from level*8000 and has a special zero-duty path. pwm_state period/duty_cycle units are nanoseconds in the pinned header.
observations.classification: static requested-state arithmetic; provider/electrical result conditional

observations.claim: The fan node includes reg=0xef00; pm8350c_pwm_data separately lists triled_base=0xef00 and channel 3 base=0xeb00. The stock direct-call/relocation inventory contains no named readl/writel, ioremap, regmap, I2C, SPI, or resource-mapping API call. This inventory does not rule out pointer-based or other indirect register access, and the numeric equality does not establish semantics.
observations.classification: address coincidence and call inventory only; no register semantics inferred

observations.claim: The stock module soft-depends on leds-qcom-lpg; pinned source has a matching compatible entry. The source scope report says the implementation search found no soc_fan C source in the searched roots.
observations.classification: dependency/source inventory; not proof of bind or complete source absence

bus_ledger.unit: uV API parameter names; overlay value 3300000; fallback 2800000

bus_ledger.driver_access: of_get_named_gpio, gpio_request, gpio_to_desc, gpiod_to_irq, request_threaded_irq, disable_irq; hrtimer enables/disables
of_get_named_gpio, gpio_to_desc, gpiod_get_raw_value, and gpiod_direction_output_raw for level-dependent GPIO output

bus_ledger.dt_binding: fan_pwm_dev compatible qcom,pm8350c-pwm, reg 0xeb00, channel 3, period cell 40000
bus_ledger.driver_access: devm_fwnode_pwm_get and three KCFI-checked ops.apply calls
no named resource-mapping/MMIO helper call in the direct-call inventory; pointer-based or indirect access is not excluded
bus_ledger.provider_relation: same numeric address as PM8350C triled_base in provider data

inferences: If this overlay is applied and the GPIO/regulator/PWM providers bind as described, the stock consumer requests its fan voltage and routes PWM channel 3 through the qcom LPG provider; current static evidence does not establish these runtime conditions.
regulator_set_voltage argument names indicate microvolt units; 3300000 corresponds to 3.3 V as a requested API value, not a measured rail voltage.

The matching qcom,pm8350c-pwm compatible, PM8350C channel map, and module softdep make leds-qcom-lpg the statically supported provider candidate, while actual runtime provider binding remains unknown.
unknowns: Whether the NX809J image applies this overlay and whether later overlays alter/disable the fan or PWM nodes.
Whether the real regulator, pinctrl, GPIO and PWM providers bind successfully on the device.
Electrical polarity, voltage and fan response under actual load; no hardware data is included.
Semantics of fan-specific properties beyond the observed stock/API behavior.
Meaning of fan node reg=0xef00 and its numeric overlap with provider triled_base; the call inventory does not exclude pointer-based or indirect MMIO, and no relation is proven.
Runtime channel state and return behavior of lpg_pwm_apply for this actual fan consumer.
requested_escalation: Independent L3/L4 review of the property-to-call mapping, channel selection, provider match, unit interpretation, and limits of the direct-call inventory. Keep overlay application and hardware behavior deferred.
revision_notes: MP6 records source and DT contracts, not physical register semantics or a test result.
The device-tree scope report says runtime overlay application is not confirmed; do not upgrade the device or hardware verdict.
Absence of named direct APIs in the call/relocation inventory is not proof that pointer-based or indirect MMIO does not occur.
No candidate source was edited and no hardware or harness tests were run.
Hash-bound PWM core and regulator OF lookup excerpts were added to substantiate period/channel-cell and supply-name translation.
